Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which indicates a space-occupying lesion such as a massive pleural-based mass or tension effusion pushing structures away, rather than atelectasis which would cause an ipsilateral shift. Among the choices provided, a large right pleural-based mass best accounts for the total opacity combined with the contralateral displacement and lung collapse.
